defects_closed.title: registration ownership discovered by owner-name pattern, not by gitdir resolution
defects_closed.root_cause: scan_worktrees iterated only `$SHOKUNIN_ROOT` and `$SHOKUNIN_ROOT/*-shokunin`. A registration owned by a directory whose name lacks the -shokunin suffix was never seen, so its target fell through to the artifact engine, matched a stale receipt and was deleted.
defects_closed.before: verify SAFE(stale) `scratch-type=scratch-dir refs=0 mtime-age-days=3`; quarantine RESULT DELETED rc=0; the dirty worktree with an unpushed branch and live active.txt was removed
defects_closed.after: verify NOT-SAFE(unpushed-branch) `branch=private unpushed=1 dir=present owner=owner`; quarantine NOT-AUTHORIZED rc=3; active.txt INTACT; no .ufo-quarantine dir created
defects_closed.fix: fleet_owner_repos() prints every repo dir under $SHOKUNIN_ROOT (dot dirs skipped) and the loop consumes it in the CURRENT shell, so Git itself answers with the registration list. An unreadable candidate owner dir sets SCAN_INCOMPLETE and every non-root target then refuses (repo-scan-incomplete) instead of falling through to artifact receipts.

defects_closed.title: duplicate registration for one path resolved last-writer-wins
defects_closed.root_cause: WT_MAP is keyed by canonical target path, so a second registration silently overwrote the first; a later pushed record masked an earlier unpushed one.
defects_closed.before: verify SAFE(metadata-prune) `dir=absent unique=0 head=40dfc8491be6 owner=owner-shokunin`; quarantine SKIPPED rc=0
defects_closed.fix: _wt_record records a second claim in WT_CONFLICT; evaluate_path refuses that target before consulting WT_MAP.

defects_closed.title: detached uniqueness masked by the registration's own linked-worktree HEAD
defects_closed.root_cause: uniqueness used `--not --all`; on Git 2.55 `--all` includes linked-worktree HEADs, so a registration's own HEAD always excluded itself and every absent detached registration read unique=0. The F1 widening above made this class reachable for owners that had previously been invisible.
defects_closed.before: verify SAFE(metadata-prune) `dir=absent unique=0 head=6fda9bd2e1b2`; quarantine SKIPPED rc=0 (a false metadata-prune receipt for a registration whose commit nothing else retains)
defects_closed.after: verify NOT-SAFE(none) `dir=absent unique=1 head=6fda9bd2e1b2`; quarantine NOT-AUTHORIZED rc=3
defects_closed.fix: uniqueness is measured against durable refs only (for-each-ref object names) after resolving HEAD to a commit with cat-file -e; any resolution or ref-query failure refuses as git-unverifiable.

defects_closed.title: repository root with a gitfile .git classified as an artifact
defects_closed.root_cause: the root test was `[ -d "$target/.git" ]`, so a repo created with `git init --separate-git-dir` (whose .git is a FILE) fell through to the artifact engine and collected SAFE(pushed) for the repository root itself.
defects_closed.before: verify SAFE(pushed) `intro=2fc86c90bdfc ref=refs/remotes/origin/main ancestor=yes` for the repo root; quarantine refused with exit 2 `not a git repo`
defects_closed.after: verify NOT-SAFE(none) `unpushed=0 dirty=0`; the same root with a valid directory ledger row is still SAFE(moved-to-obsidian); a linked-worktree root gets its own token gitfile-worktree-root instead of an artifact receipt
defects_closed.fix: a `.git` FILE is resolved through Git: gitdir == git-common-dir means the target is the repository root and is judged as a root; otherwise it is a linked-worktree root and refuses with gitfile-worktree-root. An unreadable gitdir line refuses as gitfile-root-unverifiable. Quarantine additionally accepts a gitfile repo as <repo> (no more exit-2 usage refusal) while its independent root gate still blocks staging the root.

defects_closed.title: quarantine stage 4 did not revalidate the CURRENT default ref snapshot
defects_closed.root_cause: the stage-4 pushed prong re-derived ancestry and the unpushed-touching set, but never compared the remote snapshot at the current default ref against the object authorized at stage 1. A default ref re-pointed during the hold at a commit that MODIFIES or DELETES the staged path still passed every prong and the copy was deleted.
defects_closed.before: stage4-second PASS `pin=ok mtime=ok intro=... default-ref=ok unpushed-touching=0 intro-blob=ok`; RESULT DELETED rc=0; the final default ref did not contain the path at all (`git cat-file -e refs/remotes/origin/legacy:note.txt` -> fatal)
defects_closed.after: stage4-second FAIL `... class=FAIL default-snapshot-moved` (or default-snapshot-unverifiable when the path is absent at the current ref); RESULT ABORTED rc=3; staged copy retained, bytes recoverable
defects_closed.fix: the pushed prong resolves the path at the current default ref and at the introducing commit and requires them to be the SAME object; either side unresolvable fails closed. A default ref that merely advances while the snapshot at the staged path is unchanged still deletes (control S11Q4 / matrix R6).
defects_closed.note: This contradicts peer S12's claim that F3 was already closed in the S17 base: on the installed bytes the default-ref swap deletes (see before evidence above).

defense_in_depth.quarantine_nested_repo_root: quarantine now refuses, independently of the receipt engine, any target that is itself a Git repository or worktree root (nested-repo-root). This is the r9 F05 route: an ancestor receipt must never authorize removing a nested repository's work.
defense_in_depth.quarantine_gitfile_repo: a gitfile repository root is accepted as <repo> so the root gate, not a usage error, decides its fate.
